user.title: Connect ETA heating
user.description: Enable LAN access on ETAtouch. Enter the controller IP or hostname; data points are discovered and tested automatically.

points.title: Automatically discovered data points
points.description: Found {found} readable data points. {skipped} entries could not be read (for example menu groups or temporary connection failures). All readable values are preselected. Confirm or reduce the selection. Skipped entries will not be created; repeat setup later if the connection was unstable.

progress.discovering: Discovering the menu and reading each data point. This can take several minutes; at most two requests run concurrently.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the controller menu. Check IP, port and LAN access.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname without a URL scheme or path.
error.invalid_points: Select at least one successfully tested data point.

abort.cannot_connect: Discovery could not reach the controller. Check IP, port and LAN access and restart setup.
abort.no_points: No readable data points were found. Check webservices and connectivity, then repeat setup.
